verdict.rationale: Milvus is an open-source vector database for storing and searching embeddings. Authoring, versioning, reviewing and rolling back user automations is a workflow-platform axis, not a fair question for a vector store. Nothing in the evidence shows Milvus ships any automation or workflow feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
